infoqArticles.title: PingCAP Breach Exposes Customer Records and Source Code
infoqArticles.description: PingCAP recently confirmed unauthorized access to its internal systems and the theft of source code and customer-related data. The attacker, cyber extortion group FulcrumSec, claimed to have stolen 10.6 TB of data, including TiDB Cloud control-plane records, customer SQL statements, API keys, connection logs, billing information, internal documents, and 413 private source-code repositories. By Ren
infoqArticles.author: Renato Losio

infoqArticles.title: Google Optimizes Agent Development Kit's 200K-line Python Codebase Overnight with Gemini 4 Argon
infoqArticles.description: Google explained how an 11-hour unattended run of Gemini 4 Argon produced two accepted optimizations for Google Agent Development Kit's codebase, reducing in-memory session-preparation overhead by about 40% in long sessions and cold package import time by 21%. By Sergio De Simone
infoqArticles.author: Sergio De Simone

infoqArticles.title: Google’s Data Agent Kit Hits GA, Splitting Agent Guardrails Between Skills and IAM
infoqArticles.description: Google has made Data Agent Kit generally available, a free set of MCP tools and 37 open-source skills that connect coding agents to more than fifteen Google Data Cloud services. Two kinds of guardrail ship with it, and practitioners need to tell them apart: one is a skill asking the agent to stop, the other an IAM deny policy that refuses the call. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
infoqArticles.author: Steef-Jan Wiggers

infoqArticles.title: Cloudflare Reclaims 100 TB of RAM by Optimizing Consistent Hashing
infoqArticles.description: Cloudflare recently documented how it reduced the memory footprint of its internal load-balancing service by more than 100 TB by optimizing the Rust implementation of consistent hashing in pingora-ketama. The changes compacted hash-ring entries and used statistical analysis of hash distribution and collision rates to reduce the number of hashes per backend by about 90%. By Renato Losio
infoqArticles.author: Renato Losio

infoqArticles.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
infoqArticles.description: CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database. The system combines Amazon S3, Lambda, Athena and DynamoDB, using metadata indexes and HTTP byte range requests to query compressed genomic regions. Tests reported 1.52 second average latency for 10,000 base pair queries. By Leela Kumili
infoqArticles.author: Leela Kumili

infoqArticles.title: AWS Introduces Lambda Web Functions for Node.js Applications
infoqArticles.description: AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions, allowing developers to run Node.js web applications using frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and response streaming. By Renato Losio
infoqArticles.author: Renato Losio

infoqArticles.title: Cloudflare Brings On-Demand CPU and Memory Profiling to Production Workers
infoqArticles.description: Cloudflare has introduced on-demand CPU and memory profiling for Workers and Durable Objects, allowing developers to investigate performance bottlenecks in production using interactive flamegraphs. By Craig Risi
infoqArticles.author: Craig Risi

infoqArticles.title: Article: Multi-Cloud FinOps: An Engineering Framework for Cross-Cloud Cost Optimization
infoqArticles.description: Multi-cloud flexibility comes with hidden egress costs driven by service placement and communication patterns. This article applies Backend FinOps to cross-cloud architecture, covering cost visibility through FOCUS, workload placement, synchronization models, and CI/CD-integrated cost governance. A controlled experiment shows architecture changes saved far more than rate negotiation alone. By Vive
infoqArticles.author: Vivek Arora

infoqArticles.title: Presentation: Move Fast, Don’t Break Trust: Shipping Constantly with Humans and Beyond
infoqArticles.description: Suhail Patel discusses how Monzo structures its software engineering organization and technical stack to ship safely hundreds of times a day. He shares insights into opinionated microservice abstractions, tenancy-based staging, static analysis checks, continuous profiling, demonstrating how a strong internal platform enables engineers and LLMs to iterate rapidly without sacrificing reliability. By
infoqArticles.author: Suhail Patel

infoqArticles.title: Anthropic Adds Opt-In Security Scanning for Critical Open-Source Projects
infoqArticles.description: AI company Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in service to find vulnerabilities in open-source projects. Enrolled maintainers receive periodic security reports generated by the company's strongest models, including Claude Mythos. The reports are sent without human review, and project maintainers can choose to validate their findings and decide which proposed fixes to accept. By Matt
infoqArticles.author: Matt Saunders

infoqArticles.title: NgRx 22: Resource Extensions and Dynamic Deep Signals for Angular
infoqArticles.description: NgRx 22 adds experimental resource extensions that change Angular's resource behavior, so value() is retained during reloads and no longer throws on errors. It also introduces dynamic deep signals for union types, a SignalStoreFeatureType utility, and ESLint v10 support. Upgrading requires Angular 22 and TypeScript 6.0, and most breaking changes have automated migrations. By Daniel Curtis
infoqArticles.author: Daniel Curtis

infoqArticles.title: Study Finds AI-generated Code Fails to Boost Productivity Due to Downstream Bottlenecks
infoqArticles.description: A recent Harvard study of 718 firms, using the Jellyfish analytics platform, finds that although AI coding assistants and agents increase code volume, this does not translate into a corresponding increase in completed work, partly because AI-generated code increases the workload in later stages of development, particularly code review. By Sergio De Simone
infoqArticles.author: Sergio De Simone

infoqArticles.title: Presentation: Actors for Agents: Patterns for Production AI
infoqArticles.description: Manju Rajashekhar explains how the actor model solves the complex runtime challenges of production AI agents. By treating agents as distributed systems, he discusses state ownership, message passing, write-through state, and supervision boundaries to manage failures, continuations, and mutable execution graphs, moving agentic workflows beyond fragile demos to resilient architecture. By Manju Rajas
infoqArticles.author: Manju Rajashekhar

infoqArticles.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources fx: a Zig Coding Agent Designed to Be Embedded
infoqArticles.description: Vercel Labs has released fx, an experimental open-source coding agent written in Zig. It runs as a CLI, a script component, or an embedded library, including a WebAssembly build. Early feedback questioned its model-agnostic claim and a name conflict with an existing tool. Vercel says the project is pre-1.0 and changing quickly. By Daniel Curtis

infoqArticles.title: Article: AI Changes the Data Interface, Not the Query Engine

It explains the determinism split, replayable analysis, and four signals for deciding when an embedded engine is sufficient or a managed lakehouse is justified. By Peihao Yuan
